parameters.name: storeId
parameters.description: Returns the PaymentGateways of the configuration the Store resolves to. Ignored when `paymentGatewayConfigurationId` is given.

parameters.name: paymentGatewayConfigurationId
parameters.description: Returns the PaymentGateways of one specific configuration, in the form `pgc_01kg2gestgepdbmsn7hs6bsrwp`. With neither this nor `storeId`, the default configuration of the merchant is used.

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return all payment gateways or only those that are enabled. If true, returns all payment gateways regardless of their enabled status. If false or omitted, returns only enabled payment gateways.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: An array of nested objects to include in the response.
